title: OpenDecide prediction (od-1.0)
description: One submitted prediction (DESIGN 1.2): {id, model, probs, raw_sum, invalid}. Outcomes are "yes"/"no" for Noul, option keys for Choice, and level indices "0".."K-1" for Score. Scored by analysis/score.py, which renormalises and treats invalid rows as incorrect (accuracy) and uniform (proper scores). Each prediction may depend only on its row's state and question (R13).
